summary: Proficient Auto Logistics filed an 8-K reporting the completion of a $75.0 million private offering of 5.500% convertible senior notes due 2033, issued under subscription agreements dated August 10, 2026, and an indenture with U.S. Bank Trust Company as trustee. The notes are senior, unsecured obligations maturing August 15, 2033, with semi-annual interest and conversion conditions tied to stock price thresholds. The offering represents a capital raise via convertible debt, which may be used for acquisitions or other purposes, though the filing does not specify use of proceeds. Watch for conversion triggers and potential dilution, though no repurchase or dividend is indicated.
